name: apex-psi
title: APEX PSI
description: Hosted APEX PSI evidence connector: six OAuth-protected tools over streamable-http, including one write tool (seal). Seal a record, look a hash up, read Bitcoin anchoring, browse attestations, snapshot the ledger, and read the protocol reference. An anonymous caller gets HTTP 401 with an OAuth metadata pointer — that is the Model Context Protocol asking for a session. A seal proves a record was made and has not changed, never that its contents are true. Verification is free; the hosted door needs a free APEX sign-in, the npm door does not need any account at all.

auth.note: Every tool requires a signed-in APEX session. Nothing here is anonymous.

tools.name: seal
tools.title: Seal a decision to the APEX PSI ledger
tools.description: Mint a post-quantum verifiable receipt for a machine action or decision. Canonicalises the payload, signs it (SHA-256 + Ed25519 + LMS-W4-SHA256), records it in the append-only ledger, and returns a receipt id that any agent can later re-check with verify_hash. This is the write half of the trust handshake.

tools.name: verify_hash
tools.title: Verify a hash against the APEX PSI ledger
tools.description: Look up a SHA-256 hash (commit hash or Merkle leaf hash) in the APEX PSI evidence ledger and report whether a matching attestation exists.

tools.name: anchor_status
tools.title: Bitcoin anchoring status of a sealed receipt
tools.description: Report the OpenTimestamps / Bitcoin anchoring state for a sealed receipt: whether its Merkle root has been committed to a real Bitcoin block, the block height, the transaction id and the offline `ots verify` command. Anchoring runs automatically; this reads its result — it does not trigger it.

tools.name: list_attestations
tools.title: List recent attestations
tools.description: List the most recent APEX PSI ledger attestations visible to the signed-in user, newest first.

tools.name: ledger_stats
tools.title: APEX PSI ledger statistics
tools.description: Return counts of ledger attestations, non-approved exceptions and public attestations for a quick integrity snapshot.

tools.name: protocol_info
tools.title: APEX PSI protocol reference
tools.description: Return the APEX PSI protocol reference: canonicalization, hashing, signature suites, IETF drafts, HTTP header and anchoring targets.

alternative_installs.note: A different server with different names: seal, verify, anchor, cite, verify_chain. Runs on your machine, no sign-in. Its own card is published with the npm package.
